name: [VAC] Interview Centre
desc:
Can't join the game? Join the Entrance Program group which owns the game.

Ensure that you read the instructions carefully in-game and that you have joined the Recruitment Server on this game page's social links below. You will be contacted providing you with information you need to know about VAK and VAC.

**MAKE SURE YOU HAVE PENDED FOR THE VAKTOVIAN ARMY CORPS AT https://www.roblox.com/groups/262619/Vaktovian-Army-Corps#!/about BEFORE APPLYING AND THAT YOUR INVENTORY IS PUBLIC WHICH CAN BE CHANGED IN PRIVACY SETTINGS**
